form.label: Darkmoon — MITRE ATT&CK & Technologies
form.description: ATT&CK coverage and affected technologies derived from Darkmoon findings (safe metadata only).

search.query: `darkmoon_findings` | dedup finding_key sortby -_indextime -_time | search mitre_attack_id=* | stats dc(finding_key) as findings values(severity) as severities values(title) as example_titles by mitre_attack_id mitre_attack_name | sort - findings

`darkmoon_findings` | dedup finding_key sortby -_indextime -_time | search mitre_attack_id=* | eval technique=mitre_attack_id." ".mitre_attack_name | stats dc(finding_key) as count by technique | sort - count | head 15
`darkmoon_findings` | dedup finding_key sortby -_indextime -_time | search technology=* | stats dc(finding_key) as count by technology | sort - count | head 15
`darkmoon_findings` | dedup finding_key sortby -_indextime -_time | search mitre_attack_id=* | chart dc(finding_key) over mitre_attack_name by severity
